textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 6 maths · Data Handling and Presentation · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: Any collection of facts, numbers, measures or observations that tells us something about things is called data.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: Any collection of facts, numbers, measures or observations that tells us something about things is called data. A list of favourite colours is data, and so are the weights of all the students in your class.
beats.speakEn: Any collection of facts, numbers, measures or observations that tells us something about things is called data. A list of favourite colours is data, and so are the weights of all the students in your class.

beats.en: To organise data, write each category in one column and put a tally mark for each answer. A single vertical line stands for one, and when the count reaches five, the fifth line is drawn across the previous four.
beats.speakEn: To organise data, write each category in one column and put a tally mark for each answer. A single vertical line stands for one, and when the count reaches five, the fifth line is drawn across the previous four.

type: Key Concept: Any collection of facts, numbers, measures or observations that tells us something about
Rule: To organise data, write each category in one column and put a tally mark for each answer.
